fields.Name: T131 - Routines List Surface
fields.Description: Opens the Routines app once, then exercises its bespoke command-center surface (per-routine run-history view and card-list search + status filter) in one run, verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T327, T328.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the Routines app. Then perform these sub-actions IN ORDER, and as you complete each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) routine-run-history — if at least one routine card is present, click its run-history icon (a timeline icon among the card's action buttons) to open the History view and confirm it renders a header showing 'History' for that routine and EITHER a list of run rows (each with a status chip and a start time) OR a 'No Runs Yet' empty state (if there are no routine cards at all, that is acceptable — report the list is empty); you do NOT need to open any linked run record; (2) routines-search-filter — return to the routines list, use the 'Search routines...' box to type a query and open the 'Filters' popover (funnel icon) to pick a Status other than 'All statuses' (e.g. Active or Paused), and confirm the card list RESPONDS — the visible cards narrow to matches, the X-of-Y count badge updates, OR a 'No Matching Routines' empty state appears — then clear the filters and confirm the unfiltered list returns. Keep going until both sub-actions are done. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

checkpoints.name: routine-run-history
visualCriteria: Opening a routine's history shows a History view for that routine with either run rows (status chips + timestamps) OR a 'No Runs Yet' empty state — or the routines list is legitimately empty

checkpoints.name: routines-search-filter
checkpoints.instruction: search + status filter the routine card list
visualCriteria: Typing in the 'Search routines...' box and/or choosing a Status in the Filters popover changes the visible cards, updates the count badge, or shows a 'No Matching Routines' empty state, and clearing the filters restores the unfiltered list
